chartDescriptions.neighborhoodComparison: Compares average congestion ratios across neighborhoods. Higher values indicate more congested areas. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.rushHourProfile: Congestion patterns during morning rush hours (6:00–9:00), broken down by 15-minute intervals. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.congestionOverTimeDaily: Daily trend of average congestion ratios. Tracks how traffic conditions change over the data collection period. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.timeSeries: Congestion trends over time with configurable granularity (15-min, hourly, daily, weekly). Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.dayOfWeek: Average congestion for each day of the week. Reveals weekly traffic patterns. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.rushHourCharts: Intra-day congestion profile showing how traffic varies throughout the day. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.routeRanking: Routes ranked by average congestion ratio. Identifies the most congested routes. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.distribution: Histogram showing how congestion ratio values are distributed across all measurements. Data source: Google Maps Routes API, sampled periodically via gmaps-scraper.
chartDescriptions.networkOverview: Road network metrics for each neighborhood. Data source: OpenStreetMap, processed with OSMnx (graph extraction, centrality and connectivity analysis).
chartDescriptions.congestionStructure: Scatter plot exploring relationships between road network structure metrics and traffic congestion levels. Each dot is a neighborhood. Data sources: OpenStreetMap/OSMnx (network metrics) and Google Maps Routes API (congestion).
chartDescriptions.exitAnalysis: Neighborhood exits matched to nearby traffic routes, ranked by average congestion. Data sources: OpenStreetMap/OSMnx (exit identification) and Google Maps Routes API (congestion).
chartDescriptions.bottlenecks: High-centrality intersections near congested routes. Score = betweenness × nearby congestion. Data sources: OpenStreetMap/OSMnx (centrality analysis) and Google Maps Routes API (congestion).
chartDescriptions.networkGraph: Visual road network for each neighborhood. Blue = interior nodes, Orange = perimeter nodes, Gray = exterior nodes, Green arrows = exit edges. Red line marks the neighborhood boundary. Data source: OpenStreetMap, processed with OSMnx. Aerial imagery: Esri World Imagery (ArcGIS).

node_count.label: Node Count
node_count.description: Total number of nodes (intersections and endpoints) in the road network graph. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

edge_count.label: Edge Count
edge_count.description: Total number of edges (road segments) connecting nodes in the network. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

total_street_length_m.label: Total Street Length (m)
total_street_length_m.description: Sum of all road segment lengths in meters. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

avg_street_length_m.label: Avg Street Length (m)
avg_street_length_m.description: Average length of a single road segment in meters. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

intersection_count.label: Intersection Count
intersection_count.description: Number of nodes where 3 or more roads meet (true intersections, not dead ends). Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

intersection_density_per_km2.label: Intersection Density (/km²)
intersection_density_per_km2.description: Number of intersections per square kilometer. Higher values indicate a denser street grid. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

street_density_m_per_km2.label: Street Density (m/km²)
street_density_m_per_km2.description: Total road length in meters per square kilometer of neighborhood area. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

avg_node_degree.label: Avg Node Degree
avg_node_degree.description: Average number of roads connecting at each node. Higher values mean more connected intersections. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

circuity.label: Circuity
circuity.description: Ratio of actual road distances to straight-line distances. Values near 1 mean direct routes; higher values mean more winding roads. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

betweenness_centrality.label: Betweenness Centrality
betweenness_centrality.description: Measures how often a node lies on the shortest paths between other nodes. High values indicate critical thoroughfare points that carry a lot of through-traffic. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

avg_betweenness.label: Avg Betweenness
avg_betweenness.description: Average betweenness centrality across all nodes. Indicates how evenly through-traffic is distributed in the network. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

max_betweenness.label: Max Betweenness
max_betweenness.description: Highest betweenness centrality value in the network. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx — the single most critical junction for through-traffic.

closeness_centrality.label: Closeness Centrality
closeness_centrality.description: Measures how close a node is to all other nodes via shortest paths. Higher values indicate more central, easily accessible locations. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

avg_closeness.label: Avg Closeness
avg_closeness.description: Average closeness centrality across all nodes. Higher values mean the neighborhood is overall more compact and accessible. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

max_closeness.label: Max Closeness
max_closeness.description: Highest closeness centrality. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx — the single most accessible point in the network.

avg_node_connectivity.label: Avg Node Connectivity
avg_node_connectivity.description: Average minimum number of nodes that must be removed to disconnect any pair of nodes. Higher values indicate a more resilient network. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

edge_connectivity.label: Edge Connectivity
edge_connectivity.description: Minimum number of edges (roads) that must be removed to disconnect the graph. Higher values mean fewer single points of failure. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

exit_count.label: Exit Count
exit_count.description: Number of roads leading out of the neighborhood boundary. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

area_km2.label: Area (km²)
area_km2.description: Total area of the neighborhood in square kilometers. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

interior.label: Interior
interior.description: Nodes located inside the neighborhood boundary, representing internal intersections. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

perimeter.label: Perimeter
perimeter.description: Nodes on or near the neighborhood boundary, often connecting to adjacent areas. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.

exterior.label: Exterior
exterior.description: Nodes outside the neighborhood boundary, included for network completeness. Data source: OpenStreetMap via OSMnx.
